StepAction: idle — await agent verb / provision / DAV request / export / close
route_verb — classify landing vs compute vs cache-lifecycle
Condition: heavy verb needing bulk exchange -> cache_provision

StepAction: landing_exec — PYTHONPATH over packages/*, run pure-python verb against --repo, write into caller repo, JSON envelope or typed LANDING_* error
cache_provision — find-or-mint deliverable-cache token; return mount URL + host_provision state (R14.5); mint credential ONLY on opt-in issue_webdav_credential (R14.6, rotate-on-issue)
Condition: cache provisioned; inputs staged via DAV mount

StepAction: heavy_compute — container tool reads cache tree; pcbnew/ngspice/OpenSCAD/render pipeline writes artifacts into cache namespace
dav_serve — dispatch DAV method (PROPFIND/GET/PUT/MKCOL/MOVE/COPY/LOCK) with identity + traversal + lock guards + audit log
Condition: next heavy tool call in relay chain

StepAction: export_land — export cache tree to caller truth store, stamp last_export_at; typed EXPORT_TARGET_UNREACHABLE on bad target
Condition: export landed clean; close requested -> close_reap

StepAction: close_reap — verify working tree clean since last export (or force), close cache, reaper frees namespace
blocked — typed error surfaced (AUTH_*, AUTH_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN, LANDING_PACKAGES_NOT_FOUND, WORKSPACE_CLOSE_DIRTY, EXPORT_TARGET_UNREACHABLE) — no silent fallback
Condition: caller resolves (credential / packages / export / force) -> resume prior step
